source_refs.note: Exercise 3.5, Question 3: integral of g(x) = f(x) + f(4 - x) for a piecewise f; book p. 101. Key on p. 300 under 'Exercise 3.2'.

blocks.prompt: 3 Let \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x^2 & \text{if } 0 \leq x \leq 2 \\ 2x + 1 & \text{if } 2 < x \leq 4 \end{cases}\). Here \(g(x)\) is defined as: \(g(x) = f(x) + f(4 - x)\). Compute: \(\int_{0}^{4} g(x)\,dx\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(g(x) = f(x) + f(4 - x)\) ka integral \([0, 4]\) par chahiye, aur \(f\) khud piecewise hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f\) ke do formulas (\(x = 2\) par badalte hain) aur \(g\) ki tareef.
Find kya karna hai? \(\int_0^4 g(x)\,dx\).
Rule kaunsa? \(f(4 - x)\) ka formula likhna mushkil hai, lekin Property IV batati hai ke \(\int_0^4 f(4 - x)\,dx = \int_0^4 f(x)\,dx\). Is liye jawab seedha \(2\int_0^4 f(x)\,dx\) hai.
Plan: Property IV, phir \(x = 2\) par torna, phir double.
steps:
Diya gaya: \([0, 2]\) par \(f(x) = x^2\), \((2, 4]\) par \(f(x) = 2x + 1\); \(g(x) = f(x) + f(4 - x)\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{0}^{4} g(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: Property IX (jama ka integral = integrals ka jama), Property IV (\(a = 0\), \(b = 4\)), phir Property III \(x = 2\) par. Yeh tareeqa \(f(4 - x)\) ka formula banane ki mehnat bacha leta hai.

Property IV lagayein
\[\int_{0}^{4} g(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx + \int_{0}^{4} f(4 - x)\,dx\]
\[= 2\int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\int_0^b f(b - x)\,dx = \int_0^b f(x)\,dx\); yahan \(b = 4\). Matlab: \(f(4 - x)\) ka graph \(f\) ka aaina (mirror image) hai \(x = 2\) ke ird gird, aur aaina mein area nahi badalta.

\(\int_0^4 f\) ko \(x = 2\) par torein
\[\int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{2} x^2\,dx + \int_{2}^{4} (2x + 1)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property III; \(f\) ka formula 2 par badalta hai, to har hisse par us ka apna formula.

Double karein
\[\int_{0}^{4} g(x)\,dx = 2 \cdot \dfrac{50}{3} = \dfrac{100}{3}\]
Kyun: Property IV wale qadam se.
Dhyan dein: aakhir mein 2 se multiply bhool jana aam ghalti hai; \(\frac{50}{3}\) sirf \(f\) ka integral hai, \(g\) ka nahi.

Tasdeeq: seedha \([0, 2]\) par
\[0 \leq x < 2:\ g(x) = x^2 + 2(4 - x) + 1\]
\[= x^2 - 2x + 9\]
\[\int_{0}^{2} (x^2 - 2x + 9)\,dx = \dfrac{8}{3} - 4 + 18 = \dfrac{50}{3}\]
Kyun: \(x < 2\) ho to \(4 - x > 2\), is liye \(f(4 - x)\) mein doosra formula \(2(4 - x) + 1\) lagta hai. \(g(4 - x) = g(x)\) hai, to \([2, 4]\) wala aadha bhi \(\frac{50}{3}\) dega; kul \(\frac{100}{3}\). Answer key mein bhi \(\frac{100}{3}\) hai.
